correctness.rationale: Orthogonal rank-one projector identity yields exact same-sample update I-kP; enumeration of four words yields diagonal expected squared-error matrices, and three exact factorizations give the sign equivalence. Strict derivative and endpoint inequalities give existence and uniqueness of the critical step. SymPy exact polynomial resultant/Sturm signs show that the frontier is the unique root of the stated sextic in (3/2,2). Exact rational witness checked, with 28,701 further matrix/parameter tests; computational tests are not substitutes for the analytic continuum proof.

value.rationale: A quantitative, exact phase separating RR and IID worst-start squared-error performance despite each step being nonexpansive answers a natural gap in comparative stochastic optimization. The condition-two rational witness avoids generic ill-conditioning excuses; the sharp sextic step and angular frontier enable reproducible parameter selection and theory benchmarking rather than a trivial finite enumeration.
